---
title: "analysis sample composition"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(here)
library(insect)
```

```{r}
# read in tax file
path <- '~/project_data/downy/result/asm-fcs-kraken2/oomycota-genomic/0.5/'
df <- list.files(path, pattern = '.taxonomy.rpt', full.names = T) %>% 
  map_dfr(function(x) {
    fread(x) %>% 
      mutate(sample = str_remove(basename(x), '.taxonomy.rpt'))
  })
```


```{r}
db <- taxonomy(db = 'NCBI')
tax <- get_lineage(df$`tax-id-1`, db, cores = 32)
```


```{r}
freq <- df %>% 
  group_by(sample,top_tax_name) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  arrange(desc(count)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = count)
```

```{r}
ggplot(freq) +
  geom_bar(aes(x = sample, y = count, fill = top_tax_name), stat = 'identity', show.legend = F)
```
